paper.title_en: Underwater reference-frame-independent quantum key distribution with polarization-encoding
paper.abstract_en: To address the challenges of frame drift and link interruptions in underwater quantum key distribution (QKD), we design a polarization-encoded reference-frame-independent quantum key distribution (RFI-QKD) system. Temporal coding of synchronized optical pulses combined with quantum signal discrimination enables the system to re-establish timing synchronization after a link interruption and resume key generation. With an average output photon number of 0.1, we experimentally demonstrate RFI-QKD over a 15.3 dB-loss channel, achieving a final key rate of 357 bps. Furthermore, over a 17 m underwater channel with an attenuation of 2.76 dB, the system attains a final key rate of 24.14 kbps.
